world.title: Putin orders 3-day pause in strikes against Kyiv as US delegation arrives in Russia
world.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has instructed his forces to refrain from strikes against Kyiv for three days. This decision coincides with the visit of US special representatives Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to Moscow, where they are engaging in discussions regarding the ongoing conflict. The pause aims to facilitate dialogue amid heightened tensions between Russia and the United States.

world.title: US mom hanged 2-year-old son after discussing Lindsay Clancy case with friends, called him ‘anti-Christ’
world.summary: Corie Walsh, a 38-year-old mother from the US, has been charged with first-degree murder for allegedly hanging her 2-year-old son, Barrett. The incident occurred shortly after she discussed the Lindsay Clancy case with friends. Authorities are investigating her mental state and motivations surrounding the tragic event, which has drawn significant media attention and public concern.

world.title: BRICS Should Be A 'Living Nalanda University', CJI Says At BRICS Chief Justices' Forum
world.summary: Chief Justice of India emphasized the need for a culture of “healthy disagreement and deliberation” among BRICS nations at the BRICS Chief Justices' Forum. He proposed that the grouping should transform into a “living Nalanda University,” fostering an environment that accommodates diverse legal systems and promotes collaborative learning, thereby enhancing judicial cooperation and understanding among member countries.

business.title: Ather Konark Electric Scooter Launched: Price, Range & Specs
business.summary: Ather has launched its first metal-body electric scooter, the Konark, priced starting at ₹99,999. The scooter offers a range between 100 to 161 kilometers, with some variants providing up to 200 kilometers. This new model aims to enhance Ather's presence in the electric vehicle market, showcasing advanced features and specifications tailored for consumers seeking efficient transportation options.

business.title: 8th Pay Commission: Home Rent Allowance Calculator - Can Level 7 employees get up to Rs 40,410 extra HRA per month?
business.summary: The 8th Pay Commission may revise the Home Rent Allowance (HRA) for Level 7 employees, potentially increasing monthly allowances by up to Rs 40,410. The HRA calculator considers different rates and a fitment factor of 3.0. HRA is typically linked to basic pay and city classification, impacting the overall compensation for government employees.

business.title: 2027 Toyota Innova Hycross Facelift Interior Spied - Touchscreen Hidden
business.summary: The 2027 Toyota Innova Hycross facelift has been spotted testing in India, showcasing its interior for the first time through recent spy shots. Previous sightings focused mainly on exterior modifications. The latest images reveal details about the cabin, including a hidden touchscreen, indicating significant updates to the vehicle's interior design as it prepares for its upcoming release.

technology.title: iPhone 17 gets massive discount on Flipkart: Here's how buyers can get the deal under ₹54,000
technology.summary: The iPhone 17 (256GB), originally priced at ₹82,900, is available on Flipkart for ₹53,817 through discounts and an exchange offer. To qualify for this deal, buyers must use specific credit cards and exchange an iPhone 13 in excellent condition. This limited-time offer allows customers to purchase the device at a significantly reduced price.

technology.title: GTA 6 controllers, Wolverine’s new trailer, Ghost of Yotei expansion and more: Everything announced at September State of Play
technology.summary: Sony's September State of Play showcased various announcements for PlayStation games and accessories. Highlights included the reveal of new GTA 6-themed DualSense controllers, a trailer for Marvel's Wolverine, and details about the Ghost of Yotei expansion. The event provided fans with updates on anticipated titles and new gaming accessories, enhancing excitement for upcoming releases in the PlayStation lineup.

technology.title: Jensen's Interceptor GTX is a stylish V8 grand tourer
technology.summary: The Jensen Interceptor GTX has been introduced as a track-only vehicle featuring a supercharged 6.8-liter V8 engine that produces 960 horsepower. Its design incorporates motorsports-inspired aerodynamics. The engine is derived from a General Motors LT-series unit but has undergone significant modifications by Texas-based Late Model Engines, with less than 20% of the original GM components retained.

sports.title: India's youngest double-centurion, U19 World Cup hero; Yuvraj Singh beat him to debut, back injury destroyed his career
sports.summary: At 15, he became India's youngest double-centurion, scoring 251* and showcasing his talent in various finals, including the Under-15 Challenge Cup. Despite early promise, including performances at Lord's, a back injury hampered his career progression. Yuvraj Singh debuted earlier, but the young cricketer's potential remained evident, even as injuries limited his opportunities in professional cricket.

sports.title: ‘Always in chaos, standing on one toe’: Matthew Hayden’s blunt verdict on Pakistan cricket amid latest turmoil
sports.summary: Former Australian cricketer Matthew Hayden has criticized Pakistan cricket, stating it is "always in chaos." He emphasizes that the fundamental issues plaguing the team have persisted over the years. Amid ongoing turmoil, Hayden's remarks highlight the need for significant changes within the organization to address its longstanding challenges and improve performance on the international stage.

health.title: Weight loss medicines and hair loss: New study finds genetic link in men
health.summary: A new study from NYU Langone Health indicates that weight loss medications, including Ozempic, Wegovy, and Zepbound, may increase the risk of male pattern hair loss. Men who are genetically predisposed to this condition could face an additional 7 percent risk. The findings highlight potential side effects associated with these popular weight loss drugs.

health.title: Why are you always covered in mosquito bites while others escape untouched? Scientists uncover the hidden skin chemistry that may make some people irresistible to mosquitoes
health.summary: Mosquitoes exhibit varied biting preferences based on individuals' unique skin chemistry. Research indicates that different species of mosquitoes are attracted to specific combinations of skin odors and bacteria. A study involving three disease-carrying mosquito species revealed that a person's attractiveness to these insects is influenced by the particular species present, highlighting the complexity of human-mosquito interactions.

health.title: Heart attack in the bathroom: Why straining while passing stool can be dangerous, a cardiologist explains
health.summary: Excessive straining during bowel movements can significantly stress the cardiovascular system, potentially leading to a cardiac emergency in susceptible individuals. Dr. Bipeenchandra Bhamre, a cardiac surgeon, explains that this strain can cause sudden increases in blood pressure and heart rate, which may be dangerous for those with pre-existing heart conditions. Awareness of this risk is crucial for maintaining heart health.

science.title: Chinese-German team develops levitating magnetic sensor
science.summary: Researchers from Peking University in China and Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz in Germany have created the LeMaMa magnetometer, capable of detecting femtotesla-level magnetic signals without the need for cryogenic cooling. This room-temperature device represents a significant advancement in magnetic sensing technology, potentially impacting various fields, including materials science and biomedical applications, by providing ultra-precise measurements.

science.title: Space between Earth and Moon might become a battleground: Study
science.summary: Chinese aerospace researchers indicate that future conflicts on Earth may extend into space, particularly between Earth and the Moon. They propose that spacecraft could utilize the Moon's gravitational environment for stealth and surprise attacks on Earth-based targets. Additionally, strategic positioning near "choke points" could enhance tactical advantages, potentially transforming this region into a battleground for rival nations.

science.title: Have scientists discovered a dark matter particle?
science.summary: Scientists in an old gold mine in South Dakota have conducted an experiment using liquid xenon, producing unusual particle reactions that may indicate the presence of dark matter. This invisible substance is believed to bind the universe. The findings suggest potential new signs of dark matter, although further research is needed to confirm these results and understand their implications.

entertainment.title: Aditya Hasan Gave Big Shock To Family Audience!
entertainment.summary: Aditya Hasan is a Telugu filmmaker known for his appeal among family audiences, particularly on small screens. Despite not having a major theatrical blockbuster, he gained recognition through his 90s series, which developed a loyal fan base. His work continues to resonate with viewers, establishing him as a notable figure in the contemporary Telugu film industry.

entertainment.title: Music Composer Forces Female Singers To Convert Religion?
entertainment.summary: A music composer is accused of coercing female singers to convert to his religion, raising concerns about unethical and illegal forced conversions. Such practices often involve individuals in positions of authority attempting to manipulate or brainwash others. The situation highlights ongoing issues surrounding religious freedom and the ethical implications of influencing personal beliefs through power dynamics.

entertainment.title: Updated list of NXT and developmental talents released
entertainment.summary: An updated list of released NXT and developmental talents was published at 10:50 pm ET. The individuals included are Wendy Choo, Adriana Rizzo, Zena Sterling, Anya Rune, Braxton Cole, Jasper Troy, PJ Vasa, Gary Wilson, Ellen Akesson, and Marcus Brown. This follows an original report released at 9:47 pm ET regarding these personnel changes.
